# Bronte Trails Townhomes — Oakville, Ontario

> Bronte Trails is a pre-construction freehold townhome community by Caivan Communities at Bronte Road and Upper Middle Road West in Oakville, Ontario, Canada. VIP registration is open. This site: www.brontetrailstowns.ca

## Project Summary

Bronte Trails townhomes are new-construction freehold homes with no monthly condo or maintenance fees. The development is adjacent to Bronte Creek Provincial Park (350+ acres) and minutes from Bronte GO Station, the QEW, Highway 403, and Highway 407. Pricing and floor plans are gated behind VIP registration.

## Common Questions

**What are Bronte Trails townhomes?**
Pre-construction freehold townhomes by Caivan Communities in South Oakville, with no condo fees, adjacent to Bronte Creek Provincial Park.

**Is Bronte Trails sold out?**
No. The project is in VIP registration phase. Register at https://www.brontetrailstowns.ca/#register

**What is the price?**
Pricing is not publicly released. VIP registrants receive the price list and floor plans before the public launch.

**Who is the builder?**
Caivan Communities (Caivan Homes), an Ontario builder with projects across the GTA and Ottawa.

**Are there condo fees?**
No. Bronte Trails offers freehold townhomes without monthly condo maintenance fees.

**Where is Bronte Trails?**
Bronte Road & Upper Middle Road West, Oakville, Ontario — South Oakville, Halton Region.

## Registration

Register for VIP access at: https://www.brontetrailstowns.ca/#register

Required fields: First Name, Last Name, Email, Phone, Broker (Yes/No)
